title: Agent Pay
tagline: A decentralized API database for AI agents, payable with crypto.
description:
Agent Pay is a decentralized API database for AI agents. Developers fund their agent's wallet with USDC, the agent autonomously discovers and pays for any registered service.

Businesses provide API on the platform and extend their market from humans-only to humans and AI agents in a few clicks. Built on x402, ENS, Dynamic and Ledger.
how_its_made:
Agent Pay is built on three partner technologies : 

- ENS powers the decentralized service registry. Providers register their API as a subname of agent-pay.eth, making it discoverable by any agent.
- Dynamic Node SDK creates autonomous server-side wallets for AI agents programmatically. No browser, no human interaction required.
- Ledger secures provider withdrawals via the DMK. Agent payments flow in autonomously, but moving funds out requires a physical signature on the hardware device.
auto_summary: A Next.js app where AI agents discover paid APIs, manage wallets, and process provider registrations with ENS, Dynamic, Ledger, and x402-related code.
